stock.description: Xiwang Property Holdings Company Limited, operating alongside its subsidiary companies, primarily focuses on real estate development throughout the People's Republic of China. The company's project portfolio includes both residential and commercial properties. Beyond development, it also allocates capital to property investments and is involved in the trade of construction supplies. Established in 2001, the firm was initially known as Xiwang Sugar Holdings Company Limited, before officially changing its name to Xiwang Property Holdings Company Limited in August 2013. Its corporate base is located in Zouping, PRC, and it operates as a subsidiary of Xiwang Investment Company Limited.
